title: Taiwan Extends NT$600 Airport Vouchers for Transit Travellers to 2028
summaryZh: 桃園機場轉機旅客600元抵用券延長至2028年底
summaryHi: ताओयुआन हवाई अड्डे पर ट्रांज़िट यात्रियों के NT$600 वाउचर 2028 के अंत तक बढ़ाए गए
summaryEs: Taiwán amplía hasta finales de 2028 los vales de 600 NT$ para pasajeros en tránsito en Taoyuan
summaryJa: 桃園空港の乗り継ぎ客向け600台湾ドル券、2028年末まで延長
summaryKo: 타오위안 공항 환승객 600대만달러 상품권, 2028년 말까지 연장
summaryEn: Foreign transit passengers at Taoyuan Airport can now get NT$600 vouchers until the end of 2028.
paragraphs: Taiwan has extended a scheme that gives free vouchers to transit passengers at Taoyuan International Airport, keeping it running until the end of 2028. The programme, run by the Taiwan Tourism Administration, had originally been due to end on October 31 this year.

Launched on November 1, 2025, the scheme offers NT$600 to travellers without a Taiwanese passport who are changing flights in Taiwan and enter the country for no more than 24 hours. The vouchers will now be valid until December 31, 2028, unless the available funding runs out first.

Passengers can use them at participating restaurants, duty-free outlets and other shops inside the airport. However, the vouchers are non-refundable, cannot be transferred to anyone else and cannot be swapped for cash.

Eligible travellers must first register online, providing their passport number, nationality, flight number and travel dates. Those who book in advance are given priority, as the number of vouchers is limited.

On arrival, passengers collect their voucher at the tourist service centre in Terminal 1 or Terminal 2, which is open between 7:30 and 22:30. They must show their passport together with the boarding pass for their onward flight.
Many people stop at Taoyuan Airport on the way to another country. Taiwan wants these people to visit for a short time.
Since November 2025, Taiwan has given these travellers a free voucher. It is worth NT$600. They can use it in shops and restaurants in the airport.
The plan was going to end in October 2026. Now Taiwan has made it longer. It will go on until the end of 2028, or until the money runs out.
Who can get one? You must not have a Taiwan passport. You must also come into Taiwan for 24 hours or less before your next flight.
First, sign up online. Then go to the tourist service centre in Terminal 1 or 2. Show your passport and your next boarding pass. You cannot change the voucher for cash.
sentZh: 很多人在前往其他國家的途中會在桃園機場停留。
台灣希望這些人能短暫來玩一下。
從2025年11月起，台灣就送給這些旅客免費的抵用券。
它價值新台幣600元。
他們可以在機場內的商店和餐廳使用。
這個計畫原本要在2026年10月結束。
現在台灣把它延長了。
它會持續到2028年底，或直到錢用完為止。
誰可以拿到？
你不能持有台灣護照。
你也必須在搭下一班飛機之前，入境台灣24小時以內。
首先，上網登記。
然後到第一或第二航廈的旅客服務中心。
出示你的護照和下一段航班的登機證。
抵用券不能換成現金。

paragraphs: Taiwan will keep giving free shopping vouchers to transit travellers at Taoyuan International Airport until the end of 2028. The offer is run by the Taiwan Tourism Administration.

The programme began on November 1, 2025, and was first planned to finish on October 31, 2026. Under the scheme, foreign passengers who change planes in Taiwan and enter the country for up to 24 hours can receive a voucher worth NT$600.

The vouchers can be spent at restaurants, duty-free shops and other stores that take part inside the airport. They will now be valid until December 31, 2028, but the offer may end earlier if the money runs out.

To join, travellers must register online with their passport number, nationality and flight details. After they arrive, they collect the voucher at a tourist service centre in Terminal 1 or Terminal 2, which is open from 7:30 in the morning to 10:30 at night.
They need to show their passport and the boarding pass for their next flight. The vouchers cannot be exchanged for cash or given to another person.
sentZh: 台灣將繼續送免費購物抵用券給桃園國際機場的轉機旅客，直到2028年底。
這項優惠由交通部觀光署辦理。
這個計畫於2025年11月1日開始，原本預計在2026年10月31日結束。
根據這項方案，在台灣轉機並入境最多24小時的外國旅客，可以獲得價值新台幣600元的抵用券。
抵用券可以在機場內參與的餐廳、免稅店和其他商店使用。
現在它們的有效期限到2028年12月31日，但如果經費用完，優惠可能會提早結束。
想參加的旅客必須上網登記護照號碼、國籍和航班資料。
抵達後，他們到第一或第二航廈的旅客服務中心領取抵用券，服務時間為早上7點30分到晚上10點30分。
他們需要出示護照和下一段航班的登機證。
抵用券不能換成現金，也不能轉給別人。

paragraphs: Taiwan has extended a scheme that gives free vouchers to transit passengers at Taoyuan International Airport, keeping it running until the end of 2028. The programme, run by the Taiwan Tourism Administration, had originally been due to end on October 31 this year.

Launched on November 1, 2025, the scheme offers NT$600 to travellers without a Taiwanese passport who are changing flights in Taiwan and enter the country for no more than 24 hours. The vouchers will now be valid until December 31, 2028, unless the available funding runs out first.

Passengers can use them at participating restaurants, duty-free outlets and other shops inside the airport. However, the vouchers are non-refundable, cannot be transferred to anyone else and cannot be swapped for cash.

Eligible travellers must first register online, providing their passport number, nationality, flight number and travel dates. Those who book in advance are given priority, as the number of vouchers is limited.

On arrival, passengers collect their voucher at the tourist service centre in Terminal 1 or Terminal 2, which is open between 7:30 and 22:30. They must show their passport together with the boarding pass for their onward flight.
sentZh: 台灣延長了一項發放免費抵用券給桃園國際機場轉機旅客的方案，將持續到2028年底。
這項由交通部觀光署辦理的計畫，原定今年10月31日結束。
這項方案於2025年11月1日推出，提供新台幣600元給沒有台灣護照、在台灣轉機且入境不超過24小時的旅客。
抵用券現在的有效期限延至2028年12月31日，除非經費提前用完。
旅客可在機場內參與的餐廳、免稅店及其他商店使用。
不過，抵用券不可退款、不可轉讓給他人，也不能換成現金。
符合資格的旅客必須先上網登記，提供護照號碼、國籍、航班編號和旅行日期。
由於抵用券數量有限，事先預約的人會優先領取。
抵達後，旅客到第一或第二航廈的旅客服務中心領取抵用券，開放時間為7:30至22:30。
他們必須出示護照以及下一段航班的登機證。

paragraphs: A scheme offering complimentary shopping vouchers to transit passengers at Taoyuan International Airport will now run until the end of 2028, more than two years beyond its original end date.

Introduced on November 1, 2025, the initiative entitles non-Taiwanese travellers who are changing planes, and who enter the country for a stay of 24 hours or less, to an NT$600 voucher. It had been scheduled to expire on October 31, 2026, but will now continue until December 31, 2028, or until its budget is exhausted.

The vouchers can be redeemed at participating restaurants, duty-free outlets and retailers within the airport. They carry strict conditions: they are non-refundable, non-transferable and cannot be converted into cash.

Applicants must register online in advance, supplying their passport number, nationality, flight details and travel dates. Because supplies are limited, those with an online reservation are served first.

Upon landing, eligible passengers present their passport and onward boarding pass at the tourist service centre in either terminal, which operates between 7:30 and 22:30. The extension gives stopover passengers considerably more time to take advantage of the offer.
sentZh: 一項為桃園國際機場轉機旅客提供免費購物抵用券的方案，現在將實施到2028年底，比原定結束日期多出兩年以上。
這項計畫於2025年11月1日推出，讓轉機並入境停留24小時以內的非台灣籍旅客可獲得一張新台幣600元的抵用券。
它原定於2026年10月31日到期，但現在將持續到2028年12月31日，或直到預算用罄為止。
抵用券可在機場內參與的餐廳、免稅店和零售商兌換使用。
它們附有嚴格條件：不可退款、不可轉讓，也不能兌換成現金。
申請人必須事先上網登記，提供護照號碼、國籍、航班資料和旅行日期。
由於數量有限，有線上預約的人會優先受理。
降落後，符合資格的旅客在任一航廈的旅客服務中心出示護照及接續航班的登機證，服務時間為7:30至22:30。
這次延長讓過境旅客有多得多的時間善用這項優惠。

paragraphs: Taiwan has prolonged an incentive programme that provides complimentary vouchers to transit passengers at Taoyuan International Airport, with the scheme now set to continue until the end of 2028 rather than concluding this autumn.

The initiative, administered by the Taiwan Tourism Administration, was inaugurated on November 1, 2025. It entitles travellers who do not hold a Taiwanese passport, and who enter the country for a maximum of 24 hours while changing flights, to a voucher worth NT$600. Originally scheduled to expire on October 31, 2026, the vouchers will now remain valid until December 31, 2028, provided that funding is not depleted earlier.

Recipients may spend the vouchers at participating restaurants, duty-free outlets and retailers within the airport. Nevertheless, several restrictions apply: the vouchers are non-refundable and non-transferable, and they cannot be exchanged for cash.

Prospective applicants are required to register online beforehand, submitting their passport number, nationality, flight information and travel dates. Since the number of vouchers is finite, online reservations take precedence.

Upon arrival, eligible passengers collect their voucher from the tourist service centre in Terminal 1 or Terminal 2, which operates between 7:30 and 22:30. They must present both their passport and the boarding pass for their onward journey.
sentZh: 台灣延長了一項為桃園國際機場轉機旅客提供免費抵用券的獎勵計畫，該方案將持續到2028年底，而非在今年秋天結束。
這項由交通部觀光署管理的計畫於2025年11月1日啟動。
未持台灣護照、在轉機期間入境最多24小時的旅客，可獲得價值新台幣600元的抵用券。
抵用券原定於2026年10月31日到期，現在將有效至2028年12月31日，前提是經費沒有提前用完。
領取者可在機場內參與的餐廳、免稅店和零售商使用抵用券。
不過，有幾項限制：抵用券不可退款、不可轉讓，也不能兌換現金。
有意申請者須事先上網登記，提交護照號碼、國籍、航班資訊和旅行日期。
由於抵用券數量有限，線上預約者享有優先權。
抵達後，符合資格的旅客到第一或第二航廈的旅客服務中心領取抵用券，服務時間為7:30至22:30。
他們必須同時出示護照及接續行程的登機證。

noteHi.exampleTr: शहर ने छूट योजना एक और साल के लिए बढ़ा दी।
noteHi.meaning: योजना से अधिक समय तक चलाना।

noteEs.exampleTr: La ciudad prolongó el plan de descuentos un año más.

noteJa.exampleTr: 市は割引制度をさらに1年延長した。
noteJa.usage: prolong a stay/scheme の形が多い。

prospective.en: likely to become something in the future

example.en: Prospective students can visit the campus on Saturday.
example.zh: 有意就讀的學生可在週六參觀校園。

note.meaning: 潛在的；預期的；未來可能的。

noteKo.exampleTr: 입학 희망자는 토요일에 캠퍼스를 방문할 수 있다.
